title: SEO and web performance
description: Conventions for SEO and web performance.

rules.title: Core Web Vitals
rules.text: Keep LCP, INP and CLS within the recommended thresholds.

rules.title: Canonical URLs
rules.text: Set canonical URLs and provide sitemap.xml and robots.txt.

rules.title: Structured data
rules.text: Add JSON-LD structured data to pages where it applies.

rules.title: Crawlable content
rules.text: Make sure primary content is in the initial HTML, not only rendered client-side.

rules.title: Open Graph tags
rules.text: Provide Open Graph and Twitter card metadata for shareable pages.
